title: Defense/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Lotus: "Our position has been compromised. Defend the cargo until reinforcements arrive."
- Lotus: "The enemy is at our doorstep. You must defend our equipment until reinforcements arrive."
- Lotus: "Their reinforcements are endless! Are you ready for more?"
- Lotus: "Incoming targets. You know what to do."
- Lotus: "Reinforcements are inbound. Hold the line."
- Lotus: "We are readying reinforcements. Keep fighting Tenno."
- Lotus: "Reinforcements available, do you choose to leave now or continue fighting?"
- Lotus: "Extraction is ready. Unless you can handle more of the enemy."
- Lotus: "Rest now, others will continue the battle."
- Lotus: "Go now Tenno. You have done well."
- Lotus: "Continue to defend! You will be rewarded for your bravery."
- Lotus: "Keep fighting. Another opportunity attraction will appear soon."

- Lotus: "The Queens are attempting to distill Kuva and we can't take the chance that they might be successful. Release this poison into their operation and defend the apparatus for as long as possible."
- Lotus: "The Queens hope they can create Kuva by way of this alchemy. We can't let that happen. Introduce poison into the system and defend the injector while it destroys their experiment."
- Lotus: "Quickly, activate the poison drip apparatus."
- Lotus: "Activate that apparatus to start the poison drip."
- Lotus: "The posion drip has started. Defend the apparatus while it works. The longer you hold out, the more complete the destruction of the Kuva may be."
- Lotus: "Hold on tight, the Grineer are going to do everything in the power to destroy the apparatus and salvage the experiment."
- Lotus: "What's in this sludge and why do the Queens think they can make Kuva from it?"
- Lotus: "The Queens have been frantically trying to produce more Kuva. Anything we can do to thwart their efforts will help our cause."
- Lotus: "The experiment is in ruins. Good work."
- Lotus: "This will be a massive setback for the Queens."
- Lotus: "Well done. There will be no Kuva for the Queens today."
- Lotus: "This is a defense mission. Protect these two shuttles while Tenno operatives on the inside load them up with valuable resources."
- Lotus: "We're raiding this transport for valuable materials. Defend these two shuttles while Tenno operatives on the inside Load them with goods."
- Lotus: "The longer you can defend these shuttles, the more supplies we can confiscate."
- Lotus: "The shuttles are in separate docking bays. You will have to decide on the best strategy to keep them both safe."
- Lotus: "Tenno, Alpha shuttle will not last much longer"
- Lotus: "Alpha shuttle is taking direct hits."
- Lotus: "We lost the Alpha shuttle. Focus on Beta."
- Lotus: "Alpha shuttle lost. Make sure the same thing doesn't happen to Beta."
- Lotus: "Beta shuttle is under heavy fire."
- Lotus: "Beta shuttle is sustaining heavy damage."
- Lotus: "Beta shuttle can't take much more of this."
- Lotus: "Beta shuttle has been destroyed. Save the remaining shuttle."
- Lotus: "Beta shuttle has been destroyed. Failure to protect Alpha shuttle will result in mission failure."
- Lotus: "Our shuttles have been destroyed. This mission is over."
- Lotus: "You failed to protect the shuttles. This mission is a failure."
- Lotus: "We lost the shuttles. There's nothing more we can do here."
- Viktor: "Flare, you flaunted your Rot and your bandmates paid the price. Now you'll get your new friends killed too? How noble."
- Viktor: "The "artist" Flare is a known agitator, willfully corrupted by Techrot. This cacophony ends. Immediately."
- Viktor: "Flare, you are wanted for arrest, trial, and execution. By the sound of it, your agonized screeching has already begun. Perhaps we can crank it up a few octaves? "
- Flare: "They wouldn't let you come to us. So we're gonna play this thing so loud that every corner of the city hears the sound of our resistance!"
Flare: "They said that if we played, they'd kill us."
Flare: "We are Temple and The Rippers, but we will never be silenced."
Flare: "This one is for my bandmates who never got a chance to play for you."
- Lizzie: "If the music lives, they live."
Flare: "Shout out to all those freedom fighters listening on Mobile Voice Radio! I know you can hear us."
- Viktor: "Move in now. Shut it down."
- Viktor: "Scaldra, rally and attack. Stop the Hex. Stop Flare and what's left of the Rippers."
- Viktor: "First Scaldra soldier to bring me that guitar gets a week of leave."
- Viktor: "Shut down this shameful insolence at once."
- Viktor: "This isn't music. This isn't art. It's a blatant display of Techrot propaganda and I will not stand for it."
- Viktor: "The Techrot known as Flare is a fugitive, a degenerate, and a vile musician. Silence Flare NOW!"
- Viktor: "Höllvania, cover your ears. I will protect you from this, this sonic onslaught."
- Viktor: "Flare. You abomination. You nasty chimera. You are choosing to rub our faces in your disgusting mutations. I will teach you shame."
- Flare: "Come on, let's bring the house down."
- Flare: "We're not even half way through this set list."
- Flare: "We could dip into our back catalog."
- Flare: "Should we stay or should we go. Hmm… That could actually make a good song."
- Flare: "Let's give it another go, sugar."
- Flare: "Hear that? They still want more."
- Lizzie: "You cannot be spent, demon! Not while We seethe!"
- Lizzie: "Come on. You know little Viktor wants to hear an encore."
- Lizzie: "We got lots more in US."
- Lizzie: "Not gonna quit now are ya?"
Viktor: "Flare, are you trying to become a martyr?"
- Flare: "Martyr? You think you can kill me?"
Viktor: "You want to help Höllvania? When you couldn't even help your bandmates?"
- Flare: "Trying to get under my skin? You of all people should know, my skin is much thicker than it used to be."
Viktor: "The fugitive Flare has brought filth to Höllvania. Filthy ideas. Filthy music. Filthy Techrot."
- Flare: "You said you were a fan. It's not our fault you didn't listen to our lyrics."
Lizzie: "Little Viktor whimpers. We made him the fool."
- Flare: "It was all in good fun. Until it wasn't."
- Flare: "I already told him, we don't have any room in this band for hack wannabes."
Flare: "What's so dangerous about a little rock & roll, Viktor?"
- Lizzie: "Does he fear the corrupted youth will rise?"
Flare: "We make music. He's killing the city. Tell me again who the real monster is?"
Flare: "A gracious shout out to my lovely friends providing security today."
Flare: "Höllvania! I need you to know: You are loved. You are needed. You are not disposable."
- Lizzie: "We quiver in harmony with our sweet Flare."
- Lizzie: "One, two, three. Can't kill We."
Flare: "Think that will shut us up?"
- Lizzie: "Little Viktor is so desperate We can smell it."
- Viktor: "Enough of this. Ready a Screamer."
- Viktor: "Let's show Flare what real vocals sound like. Release the Screamer."
- Scaldra Screamer: "You. You. You. You. Going dowwnnnnnnnn. Ahhhhhh."
- Scaldra Screamer: "Techrot, techrot, techrot, FILTH. AHHHHHHHHH."
- Scaldra Screamer: "You're going to DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DEAD."
- Scaldra Screamer: "Scaldra is my LIFE. My service. My EVERYTHING. YEAAAHH."
- Scaldra Screamer: "Smash it, shake it. Kill it, break it. Crush it, take it."
- Scaldra Screamer: "Ready or not, here I COME."
- Scaldra Screamer: "Pray for a purge. Pray for a purge. Pray for a purge."
- Scaldra Screamer: "Black sun. Blood moon. Oceans of pain are here for yooooouuuu!!!!!"
- Scaldra Screamer: "Ripped sky. Tortured earth. Nothing born and everything dies."
- Scaldra Screamer: "Abolish the abomination. Kill its creation."
- Scaldra Screamer: "Heretic… I am your salvation."
- Flare: "Get those guys out of here."
- Flare: "Must we all suffer for our art?"
- Lizzie: "Blood made Us. Blood fuels Us."
- Viktor: "Looking a little worse for wear."
- Viktor: "Should have quit while you were ahead."
- Viktor: "You picked the wrong side, Flare."
- Viktor: "Good. Now, Scaldra, erase all signs of this mess."
- Viktor: "Ah… The silence is such sweet music."
- Viktor: "Say hello to your band mates for me, Flare."
- Viktor: "Tragically, the Rippers is short one drummer. Scaldra, provide some... Percussion. Fire the mortars."
- Viktor: "Scaldra, ready the mortars. This "performance" ends now."
- Flare: "Höllvania! Stay safe, stay strong, I love you all!"
